author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/09/2019: SGH, NNDM, SWKS, MSFT, IBM, AAPL, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.62%
AAPL: +0.05%
IBM: +1.14%
CSCO: +0.67%
GOOG: Flat
Technology stocks were rising in pre-bell trading Wednesday.
Early movers include:
(-) SMART Global Holdings ( SGH ), which was tumbling more than 23% after the company reported financial results for fiscal Q1, with better-than-expected revenue and earnings that fell short of analysts' forecasts; it also provided downbeat guidance for fiscal Q2.
(+) Skyworks Solutions ( SWKS ) was more than 3% higher even as it announced that for fiscal Q1 ended Dec. 28, 2018, it now expects revenue of about $970 million, down from its prior guidance range of $1 billion - $1.02 billion.
(+) Nano Dimension ( NNDM ) was flat after it signed Amtech as the first reseller of its DragonFly Pro System in the Czech and Slovak Republics as well as adjacent areas.
